name: Failed logons followed by successful authentication
analyst_action: Review source IP, confirm user activity, check MFA status, and inspect nearby authentication events.

name: Suspicious PowerShell execution pattern
analyst_action: Collect command line, parent process, script block logs, and endpoint timeline before containment decisions.

name: Rare outbound destination from workstation
analyst_action: Validate destination reputation, compare with baseline, and check related DNS/proxy events.

name: Privileged group membership change
analyst_action: Confirm change ticket, verify administrator identity, and review recent privilege usage.

name: Security control tamper signal
analyst_action: Check EDR health, isolate only if policy requires it, and collect endpoint telemetry.
